title: Kimi moves to K2.5
summary:
Kimi moves to K2.5, vision errors become easier to diagnose, and `klein-large` gets a guardrail against GPU memory trouble.

The `kimi` route was upgraded to Kimi K2.5, with text and image input, text output, and a 256,000-token context window. New aliases include `kimi-k2.5`, `kimi-k2p5`, and `kimi-large`; the older `kimi-k2` and `kimi-k2-thinking` aliases were removed.

Claude and Gemini vision requests now return actionable client errors when an image URL cannot be fetched, rather than a generic 500. Separately, `klein-large` concurrency was reduced per container to avoid GPU out-of-memory errors, while the container limit was raised to preserve capacity.

Purchase options gained clearer labels and payment-method cues. The balance explanation now includes purchase examples, and API-key delete controls remain visible while the table scrolls.

highlights.title: Kimi moves to K2.5
highlights.text: Use `kimi` with text or image inputs and a 256,000-token context window. The route now uses Kimi K2.5. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=kimi).
